description:
FILED s473t5d (Opus, 2026-09-13) by #1501 round 5 CHECK 1.

Three files produce `1..0 # Skip ...` and 97 shortfall rows, and NONE of them
is skipping for the reason it looks like:

  t/io/socket.t      "-- $Config{d_getpbyname} undefined"      45 rows
  t/io/socketpair.t  "-- Socket not available"                  8 rows
  t/run/locale.t     "could not load the POSIX module"         44 rows

SOCKETS ARE IMPLEMENTED.  docs/socket-impl-plan.md is marked SHIPPED
2026-06-27: `p-socket`/`bind`/`connect`/`listen`/`accept`/`send`/`recv`/
`shutdown`/`getsockname`/`getpeername`/`getprotobyname`/`setsockopt`/
`getsockopt`/`socketpair` are all in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp on sb-bsd-sockets, and
lib/Socket.pm ships the constants and the pure-Perl address helpers.  What the
two files test is `%Config`:

  io/socket.t      $Config{$_} ne 'define' for qw(d_socket d_getpbyname)
                   then  $Config{extensions} =~ /\bSocket\b/
  io/socketpair.t  $Config{d_socket}, then the same extensions regex

`lib/Config.pm` has `d_socket => 'define'` and `d_socketpair => 'define'` but
NO `d_getpbyname`, and `extensions => ''`.

t/run/locale.t is the same shape one layer along: `eval { require POSIX;
POSIX->import("locale_h") }` fails, although lib/POSIX.pm exists -- the
`locale_h` EXPORT TAG is what is missing.

WHY THIS IS NOT A ONE-LINE FIX, and what to measure first: `$Config{extensions}`
is read directly by five files in perl's t/ (io/socket.t, io/socketpair.t,
op/eval.t, op/goto_xs.t, re/pat_rt_report.t), and un-skipping socket.t/
socketpair.t makes 53 rows RUN -- most of which will then fail honestly (the
files' server/client split uses real `fork`, and docs/not-supported.md's fork
section already says "t/io/socket.t/socketpair.t still need the socket-server
plumbing").  That is a legitimate census move (a shortfall becomes counted
failures) but it is a BASELINE CHURN of ~50 rows and must be measured, read row
by row and blessed with causes -- not slipped in beside other work.

ORDER: (1) add `d_getpbyname => 'define'` (PCL implements getprotobyname via
/etc/protocols, ruled s338) and measure io/socket.t's next wall; (2) decide
what `extensions` should honestly claim -- the list of shims PCL ships that
perl builds as extensions -- and measure the other three readers before
changing it; (3) POSIX's `locale_h` tag is independent and cheap.

One of the 41 REAL whole-file CPAN board failures (the USER-asked review; 138 FAIL files = 69 perl-skips + 4 fixed + 2 perl-fails + 22 ruled not-supported + 41 real).  Queued as s531a member 5 (3 Pod-Simple files) -- `briefs-and-rules-for-claude-subagents/s530/s531a-prompt.md` / `s531b-prompt.md`.

lib/Config.pm: extensions = dynamic_ext = $PCL_SHIM_EXTENSIONS, every module lib/ marks `# pcl-shim: must-win` (the one list of XS replacements) named as perl names an extension (Foo/Bar); d_getpbyname => define.  Guard Pl/t/config-extensions-01.t: row 1 recomputes the list from the marker and compares (printing the line to paste when a shim is added or removed), row 2 reads %Config through PCL; both FAIL on ade297e7.  Board: Pod-Simple enc-chars.t 5/0 (out); corpus.t runs 59 rows, 31/28 (14 #4167 CJK encodings, 14 #1389 probable); JustPod_corpus.t row 1 #1389 + *PLAN* #4167.  POSIX's locale_h tag (t/run/locale.t) NOT done -- independent.  Companion io/socket.t io/socketpair.t io/scalar.t re/pat_rt_report.t and the sweep's scalar.t (B listed): see the s531a report.  Branch head: b969a960.
